# Docs

- Atomic Angular
  - [@sinequa/atomic-angular](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/content.md): The business layer of Sinequa's Angular front-end stack — search features (auth, filters, preview, collections) composed from atomic and galactik.
  - [Getting started](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/start/content.md): Install @sinequa/atomic-angular, connect a client, sign a user in, and render a first authenticated search screen with a facet.
  - Authentication
    - [Authentication](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/auth/content.md): Sign-in, password reset and change, session guards and interceptors, and the principal store.
    - [Sign In](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/auth/sign-in/content.md): Render the credentials form or drive the SSO/OAuth/SAML/bearer handshake automatically, with declarative Signal Forms validation and safe post-login navigation.
    - [Authentication flows](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/auth/authentication-flows/content.md): How AuthGuard, the auth interceptor, SignIn and logout fit together end to end — the Angular-side orchestration on top of @sinequa/atomic's core authentication state machine.
    - [AuthGuard](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/auth/auth-guard/content.md): A functional route guard that checks authentication, loads the principal, and redirects to change-password when a credentials session's password has expired.
    - [Principal store](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/auth/principal-store/content.md): The signed-in user's data, loaded once and shared through a signal store — initials, admin status, and user-override state.
    - [Auth interceptor](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/auth/auth-interceptor/content.md): Attaches the CSRF token, bearer authorization and impersonation headers to every request built with Angular's HttpClient — the one channel the atomic client itself never sees.
    - [Change Password](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/auth/change-password/content.md): A current/new/confirm password form that signs the user back in on success, so the session is never left stale — used both as the /login?mode=changepassword route and embedded in a profile panel.
    - [Forgot Password](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/auth/forgot-password/content.md): A one-field form that requests a password-reset email — no router, no navigation, safe to drop into a dialog or a wizard step as-is.
    - [Signed Out](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/auth/signed-out/content.md): The post-logout confirmation shown on /logout — breaks the re-authentication loop that rendering the sign-in form there would cause in external auth modes.
  - Filtering results
    - [Filtering results](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/filters/content.md): Rendering facets over a query's aggregations, and turning clicks into filters — the aggregation family, the filters bar and its overflow, and what ends up applied.
    - [Aggregation](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/filters/aggregation/content.md): Render a facet as a list, a tree or a date range from a query's aggregations, and turn a click into an applied filter — with a custom item template or full control over the data.
    - [Aggregation date](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/filters/aggregation-date/content.md): Render a date facet as preset ranges plus an optional custom range, and turn a pick into an applied filter — live or deferred, controlled or not.
    - [Filters bar](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/filters/filters-bar/content.md): A toolbar listing the facets a user can filter on — one popover button per aggregation, with overflow handled by a "More" button.
    - [Filter button](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/filters/filter-button/content.md): The single-facet popover button rendered by the filters bar — one Aggregation per button, sized to fit the viewport.
    - [More](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/filters/more/content.md): The overflow surface for filters beyond the filters bar's visible count — a popover on desktop, escalating to a Dialog or a mobile Sheet.
    - [Aside filters](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/filters/aside-filters/content.md): A collapsible accordion of facets for a sidebar or drawer, with keyboard navigation jumping directly between facet headers.
    - [Applied filters](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/filters/applied-filters/content.md): Show what the query is currently filtered by, as one removable chip per value — the counterpart of the filters bar, which shows what a user can filter on.
  - Data visualization
    - [Data visualization](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/dataviz/content.md): Render a Sinequa aggregation as a heatmap, a tag or word cloud, or a Chart.js bar/pie/doughnut/timeline — all in controlled mode, like <Aggregation>.
    - [Heatmap](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/dataviz/heatmap/content.md): Render a two-dimensional aggregation as a grid of intensity-shaded cells — no charting dependency, real clickable buttons for cells and axis labels, readable by a screen reader.
    - [Tag Cloud](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/dataviz/tag-cloud/content.md): Aggregation values rendered as a wrapping list of tags sized by count — the lightweight default, with no layout algorithm and no canvas.
    - [Word Cloud](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/dataviz/word-cloud/content.md): Aggregation values packed into a compact spiral layout — large words centered, smaller ones tucked into the gaps, some rotated.
    - [Aggregation Chart](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/dataviz/aggregation-chart/content.md): A Sinequa aggregation as a bar, pie or doughnut chart, on Chart.js — an optional peer dependency, from a separate entry point.
    - [Aggregation Timeline](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/dataviz/aggregation-timeline/content.md): A time series with a drag-to-select range brush, on Chart.js — no d3, no date adapter, gap-filled buckets.
    - [Aggregation Heatmap](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/dataviz/aggregation-heatmap/content.md): The canvas sibling of Heatmap, for a two-dimensional distribution too large for the DOM — same inputs, same output payloads, one import change.
  - Preview
    - [Preview](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/preview/content.md): Rendering a document's converted preview — the iframe surface, its toolbar, a metadata header, and the directives that open or select an article into it.
    - [Preview Content](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/preview/preview-content/content.md): Render a document's converted preview in an iframe — with zoom, search-in-document, highlights, an AI-description toggle, and a Markdown fallback — from a single drop-in component.
    - [Preview Actions](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/preview/preview-actions/content.md): The toolbar overlaid on a document preview — a converter dropdown, zoom controls, search-in-document, and a highlights popover — plus a slot for app-specific actions.
    - [Preview Header](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/preview/preview-header/content.md): A collapsible metadata panel for a document preview — you provide the rows, the component owns only the collapsible shell and their two-column (key | value) layout.
    - [Preview service](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/preview/preview/content.md): Fetch a document's preview data, drive its zoom and pagination, and toggle its highlights — the service every preview component delegates to.
    - [Text Chunk](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/preview/text-chunk/content.md): Fetch surrounding-context text chunks for a document's highlight locations, from the Sinequa backend.
    - [SelectArticle](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/preview/select-article/content.md): Select an article on click or Enter — replace it as the current selection, redirect to a preview route, or emit it — from a single directive.
    - [OpenArticleOnCtrlEnter](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/preview/open-article-on-ctrl-enter/content.md): Open an article in a new browser tab when the user presses Ctrl+Enter while the host element is focused.
    - [ChildMarker](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/preview/child-marker/content.md): Mark a projected <ng-template> so a parent component can discover and render it dynamically, for structural composition patterns like a @for loop over projected children.
  - Collections & labels
    - [Collections & labels](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/collections-and-labels/content.md): Grouping documents into a user-managed collection, and tagging them with shared or personal labels.
    - [Collections](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/collections-and-labels/collections/content.md): A paginated list of the user's saved collections (baskets), with an add-to-collection dialog and a delete confirmation — built on the shared ListPanel primitives.
    - [Labels](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/collections-and-labels/labels/content.md): Public and private labels on a document — an autosuggest multi-select field, and a bulk-edit dialog that shows both fields side by side, gated by the labels web service's own configuration.
  - Document workspaces
    - [Document workspaces](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/workspaces/content.md): A user-managed set of documents — listed, opened, uploaded into, shared and previewed — as Angular components, with a custom-element build for pages that are not Angular.
    - [WorkspacesShell](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/workspaces/workspaces-shell/content.md): Show the whole workspaces view — the list, a workspace with its documents and preview, the dialogs they open and the upload tracker — from one component.
    - [List and detail](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/workspaces/list-and-detail/content.md): Lay out the workspace list and a single workspace yourself — each says what the user asked for, and your host decides where it goes.
    - [Upload documents](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/workspaces/upload-documents/content.md): Stage files, send them to a workspace as one batch over tus, and follow each one from upload to indexed — with retries and session recovery.
    - [Share a workspace](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/workspaces/share-a-workspace/content.md): Open the "Manage access" dialog to give people the owner or reader role on a workspace, change a role or take access away — each change is saved at once.
    - [Preview a document](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/workspaces/preview-a-document/content.md): Show the converted copy of a workspace document in a frame, with a zoom, a find-in-text box and an "Ask follow-up" action.
    - [Save to a workspace](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/workspaces/save-to-workspace/content.md): Let the user put documents into a workspace, or move them to another — a popover under your button, a sheet on a narrow screen — and tick workspaces to mention.
    - [Custom elements](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/workspaces/custom-elements/content.md): Use the workspaces view, the save-to-workspace picker and the mention list from a page that is not Angular, as custom elements with a prebuilt stylesheet.
  - Bookmarks & saved searches
    - [Bookmarks & saved searches](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/bookmarks-and-searches/content.md): Bookmarking individual documents, saving or recalling whole searches, and acting on a multi-document selection.
    - [Bookmarks](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/bookmarks-and-searches/bookmarks/content.md): A starred toggle button on any document, and a paginated list of the user's bookmarks — reopening one re-runs the query it came from to land back on the exact record.
    - [Saved searches](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/bookmarks-and-searches/saved-searches/content.md): Name and store a whole search — text, filters, sort, everything the URL carries — behind a starred toggle button, and reopen it later from a paginated list.
    - [Recent searches](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/bookmarks-and-searches/recent-searches/content.md): An automatically populated, paginated list of the user's past searches — the same shape as saved searches, with nothing to save explicitly.
    - [Multi-selection toolbar](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/bookmarks-and-searches/multi-selection-toolbar/content.md): A floating action bar that appears once the user has multi-selected documents — add to a collection, export, or attach to an AI assistant — backed by the shared SelectionStore.
  - Theming & app shell
    - [Theming & app shell](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/theming-and-shell/content.md): Register and switch color themes per scope, and the small components an application shell is built from — tabs, a dimming backdrop, error and loading states.
    - [Theme](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/theming-and-shell/theme/content.md): Register one or more color themes at bootstrap, then switch a scope between them (and between light/dark) at runtime through ThemeStore.
    - [ThemeProvider](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/theming-and-shell/theme-provider/content.md): Apply a scope's active theme to one element and everything under it, as CSS custom properties — nestable, so a page can mix several themes.
    - [ThemeSelector](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/theming-and-shell/theme-selector/content.md): A menu, opened from your own trigger content, listing every registered theme for a scope and switching it on click.
    - [ThemeToggle](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/theming-and-shell/theme-toggle/content.md): A labeled light/dark switch for one ThemeStore scope, built on Signal Forms' checkbox contract.
    - [Navbar Tabs](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/theming-and-shell/navbar-tabs/content.md): A tab bar generated from the Angular Router's own child-route configuration, with automatic overflow into a dropdown and optional per-tab result counts.
    - [Backdrop](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/theming-and-shell/backdrop/content.md): A full-screen dimming overlay, shown and hidden through BackdropService — not a settable input.
    - [Error](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/theming-and-shell/error/content.md): A full-page error state with an optional detail message read from the "message" query param, and a way back to a fresh sign-in attempt.
    - [Loading](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/theming-and-shell/loading/content.md): Deprecated — a spinner shown while the application initialized at a dedicated /loading route. Authentication now happens at bootstrap instead.
  - Notifications & feedback
    - [Notifications & feedback](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/notifications/content.md): Saved search alerts the server re-runs on a schedule, and the toast interceptor that surfaces a failed HttpClient request to the user.
    - [Alerts](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/notifications/alerts/content.md): List, reorder and delete a user's search alerts, and create or edit one through a callable Signal Forms dialog.
    - [Toast interceptor](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/notifications/toast/content.md): An HttpInterceptorFn that turns a failed HttpClient request into a toast for the status codes worth telling the user about, without wrapping HttpClient itself.
  - Integration
    - [Integration](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/content.md): Wiring the client, bootstrap, and cross-cutting interceptors, pipes, services and utilities into a host application.
    - [Provide a client](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/atomic-client/content.md): Give an application its own Sinequa client — its own configuration, session and event subscribers — instead of the default one backing the free functions.
    - [Serve a second backend](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/atomic-scope/content.md): Give a route or component subtree its own Sinequa client plus a self-contained copy of the library's stores and services, so two backends never leak into each other.
    - [Notify failed requests as toasts](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/atomic-notifications/content.md): Surface a failed backend request as a toast notification, without wrapping Angular's HttpClient.
    - [Bootstrap the application](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/bootstrap-app/content.md): Sign the user in and initialize the application's stores — and, optionally, its dynamic routes — before the first view renders.
    - [Cross-cutting interceptors](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/interceptors/content.md): Three Angular HttpInterceptorFn covering requests the atomic client never sees — the ui-language body field, audit metadata, and 401 recovery on the HttpClient channel.
    - [Cross-cutting pipes](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/pipes/content.md): Six template pipes with no search-specific meaning of their own — legacy filter display, a translated system string, locale-aware dates, file sizes, and search-term highlighting.
    - [Cross-cutting utilities](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/utils/content.md): Loose functions with no search-specific meaning — building a query from the current route, reading route metadata, running code in a Web Worker, and a fetch wrapper with baseline error handling.
    - [Cross-cutting services](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/services/content.md): Registering your own route components, sending custom audit events, calling a JsonMethod plugin, and reading the route the user navigated away from.
    - [Default query name resolver](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/integration/query-name-resolver/content.md): An Angular route resolver that supplies the application's default query name to a route with no explicit one.
  - Results
    - [Results](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/content.md): Running a query and rendering what comes back — the query service, autocomplete, spelling correction, sorting, empty states, and the small display components a result list is built from.
    - [Query](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/query/content.md): Run a search, tell a failed request apart from a genuine zero results, and page through a result — the service every result-rendering component in this library sits on top of.
    - [Autocomplete](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/autocomplete/content.md): Suggestions as the user types — from configured suggest queries on the server, and from the user's own recent/saved searches and bookmarks.
    - [Did You Mean](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/did-you-mean/content.md): Turn a result's spelling correction into the right message — the engine corrected the query, expanded it, or only suggests a correction — and let the user switch between the two spellings.
    - [Sort Selector](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/sort-selector/content.md): A dropdown listing the sort choices a tab or query configuration actually offers, resolved from the current result rather than passed in by hand.
    - [No Result](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/no-result/content.md): The stylized zero-match message — and where pagination for a result list actually lives, since the old Pager component is deprecated.
    - [Missing Terms](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/missing-terms/content.md): Which of the query's terms this particular document doesn't contain, struck through, each a link to re-run the search requiring all of them.
    - [Document Locator](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/document-locator/content.md): A document's place in a hierarchy, as clickable breadcrumb segments that navigate through an aggregation — and overflow into a dropdown when the container is too narrow.
    - [Metadata & Source](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/metadata-and-source/content.md): Two small, read-only display components for a result row — an article field rendered as a row of tags, and the icon identifying which source or collection a document came from.
    - [Sponsored Results](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/sponsored-results/content.md): Up to three promoted links relevant to the current query, each opening in a new window with a "PROMOTED" badge — customizable, and query-parameter overridable for testing.
    - [Converter Select](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/converter-select/content.md): The dropdown that lets a user pick which converted format previews a document, built from the app's configured converters and hidden entirely when only one applies.
    - [Infinite Scroll & Overflow](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/results/infinite-scroll-and-overflow/content.md): Two small layout directives with no visual output of their own — load more when an element enters the viewport, and count how many items actually fit before a "more" trigger.
  - Reference
    - [Reference](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/reference/content.md): Feature flags, keyboard shortcuts and user settings/profile — looked up, not learned.
    - [Feature flags](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/reference/feature-flags/content.md): Every key of the app's general.features/feedback configuration, which ones actually gate behavior, and the live admin editor for testing them.
    - [Keyboard shortcuts](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/reference/keyboard-shortcuts/content.md): Register a global or page-scoped keyboard shortcut that works on every layout, with a self-documenting help dialog and no manual cleanup.
    - [User settings](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/reference/user-settings/content.md): The signal store that persists a signed-in user's preferences — language, theme, bookmarks, recent and saved searches, baskets, alerts — to the backend.
    - [User profile](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/reference/user-profile/content.md): Load and edit the signed-in user's profile, one property at a time, through a Signal Forms field tree hosted in an imperative dialog.
    - [Highlights](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/atomic-angular/reference/highlights/content.md): The injection token configuring the five preview highlight categories — company, geo, person, extract locations, match locations — and how to override their colors.
- Galactik
  - [@sinequa/galactik](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/content.md): A pure Angular presentation library of tokens-only components — buttons, forms, overlays, navigation — for building Sinequa search UIs.
  - [Getting started](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/start/content.md): Install @sinequa/galactik, wire up its design tokens, and render a first form that opens a confirmation dialog.
  - Buttons
    - [Buttons](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/buttons/content.md): The button family — Button and the Toggle/ToggleGroup segmented control — and the variants they share.
    - [Button](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/buttons/button/content.md): Restyle native <button> elements as a Galactik button — six variants, four sizes, icon-only mode — with no wrapper component and no change to native button behavior.
    - [Toggle](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/buttons/toggle/content.md): A pill-shaped pressed/unpressed button, standalone or grouped into a segmented control built on @angular/aria/toolbar.
  - Form
    - [Form](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/content.md): Form controls — Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Input, Textarea, Search fields, Select and Autocomplete — and how they compose with Angular Signal Forms.
    - [Checkbox](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/checkbox/content.md): A native checkbox wrapped in an accessible label, with an indeterminate visual state and Signal Forms integration.
    - [Radio](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/radio/content.md): A native radio input wrapped in an accessible label, grouped by a shared name and a derived selection signal rather than a container component.
    - [Switch](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/switch/content.md): A native checkbox styled as an on/off track-and-thumb toggle, with the same Signal Forms shape as Checkbox.
    - [Input](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/input/content.md): A native input wrapped in a styled flex container that drives its focus, disabled and read-only look purely from the input's own state, with optional icon slots and a character counter.
    - [Textarea](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/textarea/content.md): A native textarea wrapped like Input, with three height strategies and a rows-independent min/max bound for content-driven auto-sizing.
    - [Search Input](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/search-input/content.md): A search field styled like InputGroup, meant to sit inline among other form fields rather than standing alone as a pill.
    - [Search Bar](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/search-bar/content.md): A self-contained, pill-shaped search field with a leading icon and built-in clear/send controls, meant to stand on its own rather than inside a form.
    - [Select](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/select/content.md): A single- or multiple-choice dropdown built on the accessible @angular/aria combobox/listbox primitives, with a fully custom trigger and option rendering when the default chrome doesn't fit.
    - [Autocomplete](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/autocomplete/content.md): An editable combobox for debounced backend search with multi-selection — labels, filter facets, people pickers — where picked values render as removable chips inside the field.
    - [Tag Input](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/form/tag-input/content.md): A free-text field that turns what is typed into removable tags — comma or Enter adds one, Backspace removes the last, duplicates are ignored.
  - Display
    - [Display](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/display/content.md): Presentation primitives — Tag, Badge, Bullet, Kbd, Avatar, List, RowGrid — with no business logic of their own.
    - [Tag](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/display/tag/content.md): A static, read-only chip for categorizing content — a document type, an applied filter shown for reference, a status label.
    - [Badge](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/display/badge/content.md): A small pastille apposed on another element — a numeric counter or a status icon — glued on with your own positioning.
    - [Bullet](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/display/bullet/content.md): A colored dot showing a status, category or priority next to a label — the dot half of Badge, without the content.
    - [Kbd](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/display/kbd/content.md): Render a single keyboard key, or a whole combination, as a visual hint — it shows the shortcut, it does not bind it.
    - [Avatar](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/display/avatar/content.md): Represent a user or entity as a picture or initials, with an automatic fallback when the image hasn't loaded yet or fails to load.
    - [List](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/display/list/content.md): An accessible list of selectable rows built on @angular/aria/listbox, with composable slots for content lists, action menus and navigation lists.
    - [RowGrid](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/display/row-grid/content.md): A keyboard-navigable ARIA grid shell for a list of rows that hold more than one focusable control — reach for it instead of List/ListItem in that case.
  - Navigation
    - [Navigation](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/navigation/content.md): Navigation components — Link, Tabs, Sidebar — for moving between views inside an application shell.
    - [Link](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/navigation/link/content.md): Style a native anchor as a navigation link, internal or external, while keeping every native and router semantic intact.
    - [Tabs](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/navigation/tabs/content.md): A thin Tailwind styling layer over Angular's official @angular/aria/tabs primitives — roles, focus and keyboard navigation come entirely from Angular.
    - [Sidebar](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/navigation/sidebar/content.md): An app navigation panel — collapsible to an icon rail on desktop, a native-dialog drawer below the mobile breakpoint — with no rail and no nested submenus.
  - Overlay
    - [Overlay](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/overlay/content.md): Components that float above the page — Dialog, Sheet, Menu, Popover, Tooltip — and the tokens and layering rules they share.
    - [Dialog](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/overlay/dialog/content.md): Open a modal or non-modal window on the native <dialog> element, and get a typed result back from an imperative call() without wiring a viewChild by hand.
    - [Sheet](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/overlay/sheet/content.md): A modal panel anchored to one edge of the viewport — the drawer pattern — built on the same native <dialog> as Dialog, with its own slide-in/out animation and scroll lock.
    - [Menu](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/overlay/menu/content.md): An accessible dropdown or contextual menu built on @angular/aria — roving focus, typeahead, unlimited nested submenus, and checkable items with no interactive control inside a menuitem.
    - [Popover](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/overlay/popover/content.md): Enhance the native HTML Popover API with Floating UI positioning — the bare primitive Menu and every other floating panel in this library are built from.
    - [Floating panel](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/overlay/floating-panel/content.md): injectFloatingPanel keeps a popup — a combobox's list, a submenu — under or beside an anchor with Floating UI, as wide as the anchor on request and in the top layer above a dialog.
    - [Tooltip](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/overlay/tooltip/content.md): A short description shown next to any element on hover and keyboard focus, placed in the top layer — the galactik replacement of the @sinequa/ui tooltip directive.
  - Layout
    - [Layout](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/layout/content.md): Panel layout — ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle — for user-resizable panel arrangements.
    - [Resizable](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/layout/resizable/content.md): Lay a row or column of panels out and let the user move the boundary between two of them, by dragging or by arrowing the handle.
  - Integration
    - [Integration](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/integration/content.md): Cross-cutting utilities for wiring galactik into a host application — the breakpoint observer service.
    - [BreakpointObserverService](/atomic-angular-docs/llms.mdx/docs/galactik/integration/breakpoint-observer/content.md): Answer one question as a signal — is the viewport narrower than the md breakpoint? — for structural choices CSS cannot express.
